checks.name: rustfmt
checks.protects: Every file is laid out the one rustfmt way, so a change shows only what it really changes.
checks.misses: Anything about what the code does; it looks at layout only.

checks.name: clippy
checks.protects: Common bugs and risky patterns Clippy knows, and any unsafe code, tests included (forbidden, so no allow can switch it back on); any warning fails.
checks.misses: Wrong logic that compiles cleanly, and unsafe code inside macros from other crates.

checks.name: cargo check
checks.protects: Type errors, borrow errors, and anything else that stops the code from compiling.
checks.misses: Wrong values of the right type.

checks.name: cargo test
checks.misses: Behavior no test describes, and tests that pass whatever the code does.

checks.name: cargo audit
checks.protects: Crates in Cargo.lock with a known security hole.
checks.misses: Holes nobody has reported yet; needs the network and the cargo-audit tool installed.

switchOffs.what: allow or expect attribute switches off a compiler or Clippy warning

skippedTests.what: ignore attribute that skips a test

assertions.what: should_panic attribute that expects a crash

testNames.what: a function in a test file (Rust marks tests with #[test] on the line above)

flakyWorkarounds.what: thread::sleep or tokio::time::sleep is a fixed wait
